title: Navigation & Coordinates
license: Public domain / US government works (USGS, NOAA, gps.gov)
note: Coordinate formats, GPS basics, magnetic declination - useful anywhere on Earth, not tied to this device's location.

title: Radio Reference

title: Emergency / Outage Reference
license: See per-entry sources in data file
note: Ready.gov/FEMA, CDC, NOAA/NWS, NFPA sourced guidance - applies nationally, not to one location.

title: First Aid Reference
license: See per-entry sources in data file
note: American Red Cross / CDC sourced overview guidance.

title: Local Information
note: Deliberately ships empty except two universal numbers (911, Poison Control) - see docs/OPERATIONAL-DECISIONS.md, Stage 6. Adds usefulness when configured; PirateBox's other reference material does not depend on it.

title: Document Library
note: Empty by design until the operator adds documents.

title: Local/Regional Map Files
note: Ready-to-use framework - add a file and one catalog entry, no code change needed. Empty by design.

title: World Reference Map
note: A static offline world map (country borders, equirectangular projection, SVG) built from Natural Earth's public-domain 1:110m country data. Sourced from Claude Code's own development environment (which has outbound network access) since this Pi itself has no general WAN path by design; no live WAN dependency after installation. Shown regardless of Travel Mode or whether Local Information is configured. See docs/OPERATIONAL-DECISIONS.md and tools/build_world_reference_map.py for the full provenance/regeneration record.

title: United States Reference Map
note: A static offline US map (all 50 states + DC, three panels: continental US plus Alaska/Hawaii insets) built from the same Natural Earth public-domain dataset family as the World Reference Map, one administrative level down. Same sourcing path (Claude Code's own development environment, one-time fetch, no ongoing WAN dependency). Shown regardless of Travel Mode. See tools/build_us_reference_map.py for the full provenance/regeneration record.
